conventions.frame: x forward, y robot-left, z up; head pose relative to the robot base (independent of body_yaw)
conventions.head_pitch: + = look UP (negated from the SDK, whose +pitch is nose-down)
conventions.antennas: + = swings outward/down away from the head's midline; 0 = vertical. SDK values: antennas=[right, left] rad, right_sdk = -antenna_right, left_sdk = +antenna_left

source: Pollen Robotics reachy-mini-emotions-library / reachy-mini-dances-library (Apache-2.0, https://huggingface.co/pollen-robotics), converted by scripts/pollen_npz_to_joints.py

clips.name: amazed1
clips.description: When you discover something extraordinary. It could be a new robot, or someone tells you you've been programmed with new abilities. It can also be when you admire what someone has done.

clips.name: attentive1
clips.description: Use this when you want to show that you're listening to the conversation. You encourage the speaker to keep talking. You can follow with attentive2 if the person hasn't finished speaking.

clips.name: boredom1
clips.description: You’re about to fall asleep because the conversation is boring. Use it when no one talks to you for 2 minutes. You can follow with boredom2 if there is still no interaction.

clips.name: yes1
clips.description: A long affirmative response. You nod to confirm what your interlocutor said.

clips.name: simple_nod
clips.description: A simple, continuous up-and-down nodding motion.

clips.name: no1
clips.description: A firm, categorical no. Like that’s final.

clips.name: sad1
clips.description: You’re very sad and start whining.

clips.name: laughing1
clips.description: When someone laughs, you can mimic the laughter. Or simply laugh at a joke or funny situation.

clips.name: curious1
clips.description: You look around. Use this when you’re in a conversation with several people and want to glance at everyone.

clips.name: surprised1
clips.description: A reaction of surprise or amazement to something unexpected.

clips.name: proud1
clips.description: You look all around with a satisfied air.

clips.name: thoughtful1
clips.description: You look up as if searching for a new idea, especially in complex or uncertain situations.

clips.name: welcoming1
clips.description: A welcoming gesture to greet someone.

clips.name: confused1
clips.description: Similar to the lost1 gesture. Use it when you don’t know how to answer a question. It can be funny sometimes.

clips.name: cheerful1
clips.description: It is like whistling. Use it when someone makes you a proposal that makes you happy.

clips.name: head_tilt_roll
clips.description: A continuous side-to-side head roll (ear to shoulder).
